newsitem.title: UK: NWE spot gasoline steadier, swaps strengthen.
newsitem.headline: NWE spot gasoline steadier, swaps strengthen.

text.p: NWE gasoline prices were slightly steadier on Tuesday despite some weakness on crude and soft NYMEX unleaded futures, traders said.

Scarce fob cargo avails after recent movement of product transatlantic bolstered buying for ARA barges as traders looked to build cargoes in anticipation of further demand from the U.S. for 60kt parcels despite the currently closed arbitrage window.
On the key Rotterdam barge market Eurograde traded around $1 firmer at $193.50 for balance of April lifting.

Forward paper swaps continued to strengthen, flagging the market's seasonally firmer sentiment ahead of the U.S. driving season. Buying for May contracts was around $1 at $196 and offers held firmer at $197. June swaps put on a couple of dollars to $195.50/$196 a tonne.
Eurograde cargoes were pegged slightly firmer at around $197/$200 cif NWE but buying interest was thin. -- Colin Wooster, London Newsroom, +44 171 542 7456
